description: Instrumented test class for recommendation filtering logic in the Android fitness app. It verifies biases by goals, preferred duration, fallback behavior, intensity bias, and category bias in the recommendations using espresso unit tests with an Android context.

classes.name: RecommendationLogicInstrumentedTest
classes.description: Test class for recommendation filtering logic that uses Android context and shared preferences to verify biases and fallback behaviors in generated recommendations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the Android context and resets shared preferences to a deterministic state before each test.

methods.name: recommended_biasesByGoals_highIntensity_whenWeightLossSelected
methods.description: Verifies that recommendations biased toward high intensity when 'weight_loss' goal is selected.

methods.name: recommended_prefersDurationNearPreference
methods.description: Ensures recommendations bias toward the user's preferred duration.

methods.name: recommended_neverEmpty_evenWhenNoGoals
methods.description: Checks that recommendations are never empty, providing fallback data even when no goals are set.

methods.name: recommended_respectsIntensityBias_strengthGivesMedium
methods.description: Tests that strength-related goals bias recommendations toward medium intensity.

methods.name: recommended_containsRecommendedCategoryOrBias
methods.description: Verifies recommendations contain items in the 'Recommended' category or matching intensity bias based on user goals.
